name: Khaumestro
backstory: Child of Mekestros and Khaubalo; grew up around works out of the temple's own records annex... in Gorff, and knows something of Birth Of Fenarnus.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Auroboro, named Mekoboro.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Khaus has died.
Heard that Mekestros and Khaubalo now have a child, Mekhaubo.
Heard that Khaubalo and Merluko now have a child, Merkhaubo.
Heard that Merluko and Khaubalo now have a child, Khaubaluk.
Heard that Khaubestro and Aureluko now have a child, Aurelkhau.
Had a child with Aurekobo, named Aurekomest.
Heard that Khaubestro and Mekhaurel now have a child, Mekhaubest.
Heard that Aurekomest and Aurelkhau now have a child, Aurelkomest.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Birth Of Nakorika their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Birth Of Nakorika as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: rides the caravan route on his father's schedule some weeks, mostly to listen rather than to drive

arc.premise: Khaumestro keeps hearing two different versions of the night the tollhouse changed hands - one from his caravan-driving side of the family, one from his temple-schooled side - and wants to check both against the actual records before he repeats either one as settled.
